ebay._comment: category_id 212 is eBay's 'Sports Trading Cards' category as of 2026. eBay occasionally renumbers categories -- if active-listing results look wrong, look up the current ID via the Taxonomy API (GET /commerce/taxonomy/v1/category_tree/0) and update this value.

ebay_alerts._comment: Used instead of the eBay API (declined account) if enabled: reads eBay's own saved-search alert emails from your Gmail inbox via IMAP. Requires you to first create a saved search + email alert on eBay's site for each watchlist player -- see README 'eBay via saved-search email alerts'. PROVISIONAL: the HTML parsing hasn't been validated against a real alert email yet.

craigslist._comment: Craigslist blocks automated scraping outright (confirmed against both headless and headed browser automation), so these just build ready-to-click search links included in the daily email instead of being fetched automatically.
